chapter.verse: Tua ahihleh Pasian in a mite nolh hiam cih kidong lehang, nolh peuhmah lo hi. Keimahmah zong Israel mi, Abraham' suan, Benjamin beh ka hi hi.
Pasian in ama' teelkholh mite nolh nailo hi. Pasian' Laibu sunga kigen thu, Elijah in Israel mite Pasian' kiangah a khiatna thu, thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Elijah in, “Topa aw, amaute in na kamsangte that khinta uh a, nangma' biakpiaktaute zong phelkhia khinta uh hi. Kei bek mah ka omlai a, kei' nuntakna zong hong suk sawm lai uh hi,” ci hi.
Himah taleh ama' tunga Pasian' dawnkikna bang ahi hiam? “Baal' mai-ah a khukdinlo mi tulsagih, keima' ading ka tuamkoih khitsa hi,” ci hi.
Tua hi a, tu hunin zong hehpihna tawh teelkhiat ahisa mi tawmkhat omlai hi.
Ahi zongin tua pen hehpihna ahih manin sepna tunga kinga hi nawnlo hi. Hi hileh hehpihna i cih pen hehpihna kici thei nawnlo ding hi.
Tua ahihleh bangci dan ahi hiam? Israel mite in a zonzon uh ngah lo uh hi. Teelkhiat mite in ngah uh a, a dang teng ahihleh lungsim khauhin om uh hi.
Hih bangin zong kigelh hi: “Pasian in tuni ciangdong mah amaute' tungah lungmawlna kha pia a, khuamu theilo mitte leh khuaza theilo bilte pia hi.”
David in zong hih bangin ci hi: “A ankuang uh thangzak leh tehlop suak henla, khemthuakna leh gawtthukna hita hen.
A muh loh nadingun a mitte uh mial henla vangik pua-in a nungzang uh kuulcip den ta uh hen.”
Tua ahihleh amaute a puk nadingun a kipalkha uh ahi hiam? Hi dek lo hi. Eenna a neih nadingun amaute' tatkhialhna hangin Gentile mite' kiangah hotkhiatna a tung hizaw hi.
Tua hi a, amaute' tatkhialhna in leitung mite hauhna tunin amaute' cinlahna in Gentile mite hauhna tun ahihleh amaute' bucing kikhelna in a lianzaw tun kan ding hilo hiam?
Tu-in no Gentile mite' tungah thu hong gen ka hi hi. Gentile mite' kianga nasem ding sawltak khat ka hihna tawh ka seppina ka thupisak a,
tua pen ka Jew mipihte in eenna a neih theih nading leh tua tungtawnin amaute kimkhat ka hotkhiat theih nading ahi hi.
A hang pen amaute a kinolhna panin leitung mite' kilemkikna piang ahihleh amaute a kisanna pana piang pen misite' hinkikna cihloh thudang om ding ahi hiam?
Anpal dinga kipia buhneel a siantholeh buhneel lompi zong a siangtho hi a, singzung a siantho leh a hiangte zong a siangtho ahi hi.
Thukhat ah, singhiang kimkhat kiheuhkhia-in nang pen gamlak olive nam ahi kimlai tua munte ah hong kihiangpehin tu-in olive zung ii ginatna ngahkhawm zangkhawm na hihleh
tua olive hiangte' tungah kisial kei in. Na tuaci hih leh olive zung nang' hinsak hilo-in olive kung in nang hong hingsak hizaw cih phawk in.
Tua hileh, “Kei hong kihiangpeh nadingin singhiangte kiheuhkhia,” na ci ding hi.
Maan hi. Amaute a uplohna uh hangin a kiheuhkhia hi a, nang na hihleh upna tawh a dingkip na hi hi. Tua ahih manin kiphasak kei inla, lauthawngzaw in.
A hang pen Pasian in pianngeizui singhiangte nangawn map lo ahihleh nang zong hong map tuanlo ding hi.

Tua ahih manin Pasian' migitna leh guhgamna phawk thei in: a pialte' tungah amah guhgam a, ahi zongin ama' migitna sungah na omzom nakleh nang' tungah hong migi ding hi. Na omzom keileh nang zong hong kisatkhia ding hi.
Pasian in singhiang pehkik thei ahih manin amaute nangawn a uplohna uh a zopsuak kei nak uhleh a hiang uh kipehkik ding hi.

Tua hi a, nang pen pianngeizia thu ah gamlak olive ahi singkung pan hong kisatkhia-in pianngeizia ahilo, a kiciing olive singkung khat ah hong kihiangpeh ahihleh hih pianngeizia pana singhiangte amau' olive singkung pen ah kipehkikzaw kan ding hilo hiam?

Sanggamte aw, nomaumah pil na kisaktawm loh nadingun hih thusim a thei lo na hih ding uh kong deihsak kei hi: Gentile mite a bucingin hong lut khit mateng Israel mite lakah hilhhakna kimkhat a om ahi hi.

Tua hi a, Israel mite a vekun tu-a danin hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi. Tua pen a nuai-a a kigelhsa bang ahi hi: “Zion pan Honpa hong paikhia ding a, Jacob' suan lakpan kihtakbei gamtatna hepkhiatsak ding hi.
Tua pen amaute tawh ka thuciamna hi a, amau' mawhnate ka lakkhiatsak ciangin zong tua mah hiding hi.”
Amaute pen Lungdamna Thu vai ah note' hamphat nadingin galte suak uh a, ahih hangin teelkhiatna vai ah amau' pupite' hangin itte ngaihte ahi uh hi.
A hang pen Pasian' hehpihna gahte leh ama' hong sapkhiatna pen khelkik theih hilo hi.
Note hun khat lai-in Pasian' thu na man loh uh hangin tu-in amau' thumanlohna huhau-in thukhualna na ngah uh hi.
Tua pen note' tunga hong kilak thukhualna hangin amaute zong tu-in thukhualna a ngah theih nadingun tu laitak a thumanglo uh ahi hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian in vekpi' tungah thukhualna a lah theih nadingin a vekpi-un thumanlohna sungah koihdak hi.
Pasian a hauhna, a pilna leh a thutheihna bangzahin thuk hiam? Ama' thukhennate theihkhiat zawh hilo a, ama' totna lampite muhkhiat zawh hilo hi.
“A hang pen kua in Topa' lungsim thei-in kua in ama' thukuppih sem ngei ahi hiam?
Ahihkeileh zong kua in siamthuh a ngah nadingin ama' kiangah khuttawi va keng ngei ahi hiam?”
A hang pen na khempeuh ama' kiangpan hi a, ama' tungtawnin leh ama' adingin a piang ahi hi. Ama' tungah minpha om tawntung ta hen. Amen.
